# Muse Hub

> Muse Hub is an open-source toolkit for Meta's Muse AI personal assistant, bringing together AI agent skills, workflow automation, custom tools and service connectors. Download 15 specialist assistants with Main and three subchats, choose from 5242 skills, 396 workflows and 558 task starters, and browse 273 connector guides. Explore Companion Home, persistent notes, Studio, Arcade, terminal tools, custom skill packs and a 63-resource library.

## Choose a resource

Specialist ZIPs include instructions, subchat guides, selected skills, workflows, and a first task. Use the guides directly in Muse; use Python 3.12+ for the optional toolkit commands.

Start with a journey for the task, then follow the setup guide for each tool or service you choose. Search the library by task or specialist; preview and build a custom pack when you want a focused set of skills and workflows.
